transaction_foreign_check.name: transaction_foreign_check
transaction_foreign_check.value: ("transaction"."foreign_amount_minor" IS NULL) = ("transaction"."foreign_currency" IS NULL) AND ("transaction"."foreign_currency" IS NULL) = ("transaction"."foreign_currency_exponent" IS NULL)

budget_custom_range_check.name: budget_custom_range_check
budget_custom_range_check.value: "budget"."period_rule" <> 'custom' OR ("budget"."custom_start" IS NOT NULL AND "budget"."custom_end" IS NOT NULL AND "budget"."custom_start" <= "budget"."custom_end")

recurring_rule_dates_check.name: recurring_rule_dates_check
recurring_rule_dates_check.value: length("recurring_rule"."anchor_date") = 10 AND ("recurring_rule"."ends_on" IS NULL OR length("recurring_rule"."ends_on") = 10) AND ("recurring_rule"."paused_on" IS NULL OR length("recurring_rule"."paused_on") = 10) AND ("recurring_rule"."resumed_on" IS NULL OR length("recurring_rule"."resumed_on") = 10) AND ("recurring_rule"."ended_on" IS NULL OR length("recurring_rule"."ended_on") = 10)

recurring_rule_custom_check.name: recurring_rule_custom_check
recurring_rule_custom_check.value: ("recurring_rule"."cadence" <> 'custom' AND "recurring_rule"."custom_every" IS NULL AND "recurring_rule"."custom_unit" IS NULL) OR ("recurring_rule"."cadence" = 'custom' AND "recurring_rule"."custom_every" BETWEEN 1 AND 99 AND "recurring_rule"."custom_unit" IN ('days','weeks','months'))
